sisi.depan: A wide flight of polished black crystal stairs leads up to a high-backed, faceted black crystal throne set against a wall of smooth, dark-blue crystal panels where cold blue light emanates from the seams.
sisi.kanan: A single, enormous, floor-to-ceiling faceted window of transparent crystal offers a view of a dark, stormy sky over a city of glowing geometric structures.
sisi.belakang: A massive, arch-less portal with sliding doors made of a single slab of obsidian-like material stands open, flanked by two tall, featureless pillars of dark metal.
sisi.kiri: Three towering, chunky pylons of glowing blue crystal pulse slowly with internal light, set into deep alcoves along the smooth, dark-blue crystal wall.

tengah: A wide, reflective walkway of polished black crystal leads from the entrance towards the stairs.
atas: The ceiling is a vast, smooth dome of dark-blue crystal, with a single, large, multi-faceted crystal formation suspended at its apex that casts a cold, diffuse blue light downwards.
